_attribution: Rule content ported from the herdr project's battle-tested detection manifests (src/detect/manifests/cline.toml, Apache-2.0), remapped to RFC-0004 vocabulary: blocked->waiting, idle->done. Nested any/all conjunctions flattened into rule multiplication or regex alternations; osc_progress rules dropped (no channel); loosenings noted inline where exact fidelity was impossible.
_dropped_default_working: herdr's cline.toml ends with a catch-all `regex: '(?s).+'` scoped to region 'whole_recent'. This engine has no recency-scoped region — every region it offers says WHERE to look, none says WHEN — so the rule would match any non-empty terminal and assert `working` unconditionally. Dropped rather than approximated: restoring it needs a recency region in the engine and calibration against a live cline. See WI-2026-08-14-005.
